title: ½ Price: KB's Salt/Lemon & Pepper Squid 360g & Coconut Crumbed/Tempura Prawns 300g $5.50 @ Coles
body:
Deal: ½ Price: KB's Salt/Lemon & Pepper Squid 360g & Coconut Crumbed/Tempura Prawns 300g $5.50 @ Coles

[QuickToThePointless] Packed in China from imported and local ingredients. For human consumption only. Not to be used as bait or fed to aquatic animals.
Any good, you ask?
Not good enough for anything but undiscerning humans, apparently
[Rilakkujay] They said squid is bad for you, proof me wrong.
[Lizard Spock] Did you read it in Proof magazine? Or the other one for magicians?
[QuickToThePointless] Who are "they"?
Do other people hear "them"?
[CashMachine10] The squid from Aldi is so much better than this. KB is too heavy on the batter (even when air fried). Aldi's squid has a better texture and is much more flavourful too.
[DocC] Prefer the KB Lemon Pepper Squid taste but worth noting nutrition info per 100g:
KB Lemon Pepper Squid ALDI Salt n Pepper Squid
Energy 753kJ 814kJ
Protein 10.8g 8.7g
Fat, Total 11.1g 8.5g
- Saturated 1.8g 1.3g
Carbohydrate 9g 20.7g
- Sugars Less than 1g 0.6g
Sodium 506mg 590mg
Pretty comparable over most metrics but KB somewhat higher protein (and fat) and less than half the carbohydrate content whilst also lower kJ.
[DocC] Formatting didn't quite work, left colum is KB, right is ALDI
[CashMachine10] Thanks for the comparison. However you accidently compared the wrong squid. The KB salt and pepper squid carbs is 20g. Fat is 14g, sodum 635mg
[DocC] No accident I like the lemon pepper both for the nutrition numbers and the taste! Didn't realise aldi do a lemon pepper so was comparing with their salt and pepper?
[Assburg] Good to see another critique.. these KB squids have lots of ice in the pack.
[tequilatime] Just don't look at the ingredients list. It's like a Year 12 chemistry experiment
[bluespider] Looks like they no longer have Lemon and Pepper Prawns? It was so good :(
[Damned] Tried they arnt bad.. Stop buying when i noticed china product, not saying its bad, Just not for me
[shkippy] It's completely free aside from a few features that helps save time like one-tap send to trolley.
And being able to see any price history beyond a month.
After "1 month free" it's $40, it's not a great price, compared to the likes of 3xCamels who do it for free on amazon.
[PappaLuigi] Australia.. surrounded by sea.. BUT GOD FORBID WE HAVE CHEAP SEAFOOD.. have to get it from China/Vietnam.. no thanks
[QuickToThePointless] Our home is girt by sea
Our supermarkets: girt by foreign seafoods
[team teri] For the Gyoza Aldi wins on price. In terms of quality: seem very similar.
[cashbackman] Only 2/10 of these are Australian made…
No thanks.
Buy food that supports Australian jobs in all 3 tiers of the supply chain.
[rehan770] I reckon it's good for bite size with some Alcohol.
